description: Set text wrap on page items: no wrap, wrap around the bounding box, wrap around the object shape, jump object or jump to next column; invert, offsets, wrap to (sides, towards or away from the spine, largest area), contour options and Apply to Parent Page Only (Window > Text Wrap)

applyToParentPageOnly.description: Apply to Parent Page Only (items on parent pages)

contour.description: Contour Options, for a wrap around the object shape

pathName.description: Alpha channel or Photoshop path name, for those contour types

invert.description: Invert: wrap text inside the shape

offset.description: Wrap offset (a wrap around an object shape uses one value: all, or top) in mm. Give all, or any of top, left, bottom, right (sides not given keep their value)

all.description: The same value on every side, in mm

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

wrapTo.description: Wrap To: which sides of the object text wraps on

name: set_text_wrap
title: Set Text Wrap
